agreement.intro: I confirm that I have read the information about personal data processing in Sonary and consent to the processing of my data under the terms of this document.

agreement.purposes_text: Data is used for account creation and operation, authorization, saving settings, operating the music diary, storing user content, ensuring security, restoring access, diagnosing errors, and improving Sonary features.
agreement.privacy_text: Sonary does not sell personal data or share it with advertisers. Third-party access is allowed only to the extent necessary for service operation, user protection, or legal compliance.
agreement.public_private_text: Users independently determine the publicity of available profile settings. Data designated as private by the interface is not intended for display to other users.
agreement.uploads_text: Files may be stored and technically processed to the extent necessary for chosen features to work. Sonary does not acquire ownership rights to user materials.
agreement.statistics_text: With separate consent, aggregated information about section usage, errors, device type, and technical performance metrics may be collected.
agreement.security_text: Sonary takes reasonable protective measures. Data is stored no longer than necessary for processing purposes, dispute resolution, security, and legal requirements.
agreement.rights_text: Users have the right to request information about processing, correction or deletion of data, restriction of processing, and withdrawal of previously granted consent in cases provided by law.

about.title: About Sonary
about.music_more_than_history: Music is more than a list of plays
about.intro: Sonary is a music diary created to save not just tracks, but the impressions tied to them.
about.collection: Here you can add music to your collection, rate it, write your own notes and reviews, mark your mood, and build playlists. Over time, individual entries form a personal history of the music you listened to and what it meant to you.
about.services_remember: Most music services are good at remembering what we listen to. But much rarely — what we thought about it.
about.idea: Sonary came from a simple idea: build a place you can return to months or years later and see not just a track title, but your own thoughts at that moment.
about.questions: Which song was on repeat this summer? Which album did you dislike at first, only for it to become a favorite later? What were you listening to during a specific time in your life? Sonary is made for exactly these things.
about.project_description: Sonary is an independent passion project. It was not created as a startup and is not built around making as much money as possible. There is no goal to retain users at any cost, turn every feature into a paid subscription, or clutter the interface with ads.
about.project_approach: We want to experiment with design, add interesting features, learn new things, and gradually turn Sonary into a product we'd love to use ourselves. That's why decisions are made not just by what's most profitable, but by what makes Sonary better.
about.your_music_text: Everyone has a unique relationship with music. So Sonary doesn't try to dictate what you should like. There are no 'correct' ratings or opinions here.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: Here are answers to the main questions about Sonary. If the answer you need isn't here — we might just haven't added it yet.
faq.what_is_text: It's a music diary where you can save tracks, rate them, write impressions, create playlists, and build your own music history.
faq.streaming_text: No. Sonary does not try to replace Spotify, Apple Music, or other services. The main idea is to preserve impressions of music.
faq.free_text: Yes. It's a passion project; core features will be available without a subscription.
faq.reviews_text: You don't have to write a full review. A quick thought or impression that will be interesting to revisit later is enough.
faq.playlists_text: Yes. Saved tracks can be grouped into themed collections: favorite tracks of the year, music from a life period, or mood selections.
faq.mood_text: Mood adds context to a music memory: the same track can be associated with different periods and emotions.
faq.edit_title: Can I edit an entry later?
faq.edit_text: Yes. Opinions on tracks can change — and that's completely normal.
faq.private_playlist_title: Can I make a playlist private?
faq.private_playlist_text: Yes. Private playlists are accessible only to the owner and are not displayed publicly.
faq.data_text: We aim to collect only data necessary for Sonary to operate. Details are described in the Terms of Use.
faq.ads_text: Sonary is not built as an ad platform. The project's goal is to develop the product itself, not monetize attention.
faq.team_text: It's an independent project that is gradually evolving through a shared passion for music, design, and software development.
faq.development_text: Yes. Features and interface may change. If you have an idea, comment, or found a bug — feedback is always appreciated.
